name: Bi2Te3 rhombohedral primitive 5-atom cell
purpose: Thermoelectric sidecar reference (PRD §L1.5: thermoelectric ZT path) — Bi2Te3 is the canonical room-temperature TE benchmark (ZT ~1).
notes: Rhombohedral primitive (a_R = 10.473 Å, alpha = 24.159°). Conventional hexagonal a = 4.3835 Å, c = 30.487 Å. Space group R-3m (#166). 2 Bi + 3 Te = 5 atoms in primitive cell.
